title: Living with Artificial Intelligence | Slow English Reading & Listening Practice #Shorts

subtitles.en: Artificial intelligence is quietly changing how we live and work each day.
subtitles.zh: 人工智慧正在悄悄改變我們每天的生活與工作方式。

subtitles.en: Many people use smart tools to draft emails, organize schedules, and learn new skills faster.
subtitles.zh: 許多人使用智慧工具來撰寫電子郵件、安排行程並更快速地學習新技能。

subtitles.en: Instead of replacing our creativity, modern technology helps us save valuable time.
subtitles.zh: 現代科技不僅沒有取代我們的創造力，反而幫助我們節省了寶貴的時間。

subtitles.en: When repetitive tasks disappear, we have more mental energy to connect with people and explore new ideas.
subtitles.zh: 當重複性的工作消失後，我們便有更多的心理能量與人交流並探索新點子。

subtitles.en: Using simple tools wisely can boost daily efficiency and open new possibilities.
subtitles.zh: 明智地使用簡單工具可以提升日常效率，並開啟無限可能。
